Section: 02The premise

Software is the easy part. The process around it is the hard part.

Axleta was launched in 2018 as an IT service firm supplying technology-driven systems and solutions for SMEs.

The firm was founded to give businesses technological solutions that enable business process advancement. We work with you to build a successful business using technology that suits your business scenario, and we treat that as a partnership — one that keeps your business context current as the technology moves.

We value simplicity and we respect your values. Every engagement is worked through specific, measurable, achievable, realistic and time-bound objectives.

Be the technological companion in your business.

Find the right technology to suit the requirement, and advance the business function so the business succeeds. Our solutions are chosen for cost-effectiveness and fitness of purpose.

01ERP

ERP / BUSINESS SYSTEMS

ERP applications

SAP Business One and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, selected against how your business actually operates.

A business system is only useful when it fits the process around it. We start from how work is really done — quoting, purchasing, stock, production, invoicing — and then choose the platform that carries it. SAP Business One and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud cover the same core ground; the right choice depends on your scale, your hosting model and how far you intend to take customisation.

What this covers

SAP Business One
A single system for sales, purchasing, financials, inventory, manufacturing and MRP.
SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud
The cloud generation of SAP ERP, for businesses that want a managed platform.
Sales
Quotation through order, pricing, credit control and the pipeline behind it.
Purchasing
Requisition, purchase orders, approvals, receipts and supplier performance.
Financial management
Accounting, ledgers, budgeting, period close and reporting.
Banking integration
Direct data exchange with your bank so statements and payments reconcile without rekeying.
Inventory
Warehouses, stock transfers, valuation and the physical count behind the number.
Manufacturing & MRP
Bills of material, work orders, production planning and material requirements.

Plate 01 — erp / business systems

02Applications

APPLICATIONS / ADD-ONS

Companion applications

Purpose-built add-ons that extend your ERP into the parts of the process it does not cover on its own.

Standard ERP coverage stops at a certain point. Everything past it — material handling, technical data, fixed assets, analytics, barcode capture, online payment — is usually where a real business feels the friction. We build those pieces as companion applications that sit alongside the ERP and read from it, rather than forking it.

What this covers

Material management
A material management system integrated with SAP Business One.
Technical & product development
Structured technical and product development records tied to items and processes.
Product lifecycle management
PLM for SAP Business One, keeping product data consistent across the cycle.
Fixed assets
A fixed assets management system for register, depreciation and disposal.
Sales analytics
A web application for reporting on sales performance against SAP Business One.
Inventory transfer automation
Automated stock transfers with the posting handled, not hand-keyed.
Barcode generation & management
Label and barcode generation and management for SAP Business One.
Online payment & bank integration
An online payment system wired to your bank.
Discuss applications→How we deliver→

Plate 02 — applications / add-ons

03Infrastructure

INFRASTRUCTURE / CLOUD

Technology infrastructure

The foundation everything else runs on — compute, network, storage, security and virtualisation.

Application work is only as good as the ground it runs on. A client–server architecture is not optional once transactions, processing and reporting are involved, because the server carries a very different load from a workstation. We design, deploy and maintain that layer so the business software above it has something dependable to run on.

What this covers

Private cloud
Private cloud infrastructure with dedicated servers, built for cost-effective stability.
Dedicated servers
Dedicated compute for processing, storing and analysing business data.
LAN / WAN networks
Network and IT infrastructure redesign to raise system performance.
Remote access
Reach your systems from anywhere using Microsoft Remote Desktop Web Service.
Data storage
Secure storage over cloud infrastructure, built around integrity, consistency and reliability.
IT security
Infrastructure and security measures to protect systems and data from vulnerabilities.
Virtualisation
Virtualised servers and storage on Proxmox, allocating only the resources a service needs.
Discuss infrastructure→How we deliver→

Plate 03 — infrastructure / cloud

04Automation

AUTOMATION / RPA

Automation & integration

Process automation, system integration and applied generative AI — where manual work is genuinely removable.

Automation is worth doing where the work is repetitive, rule-bound and already proven. That is usually data entry, document handling, reconciliation, and moving information between systems that were never designed to talk. We also work with generative AI, applying it to the processes where it removes effort rather than the ones where it merely sounds impressive.

What this covers

Workflow automation
Automating the hand-offs and re-keying between systems and teams.
RPA
Robotic process automation for repetitive, rule-bound back-office work.
System integration
Connecting ERP, add-ons, banking and infrastructure into one flow of data.
Generative AI
Applied generative AI for process automation, introduced where it earns its cost.
Discuss automation→How we deliver→

Plate 04 — automation / rpa

05How it fits

One stack, not four departments.

Infrastructure carries the ERP. Companion applications extend it. Automation threads across both. Designing them separately is how businesses end up with a system nobody can maintain.

We work from the bottom up. A partner application that ignores the network and the storage it depends on is a liability, and an automation that ignores the process it touches is a nuisance. Each layer is specified in the same conversation as the one below it.

Section: 06How we engage

Requirement first. Delivery second. Support after that.

Four stages, in order. Each one produces something you can look at before the next one starts, and going live is the midpoint rather than the finish line.

All services→

Published services: requirement analysis, ERP consultancy, strategic consultancy, customised add-on development, project management, resource allocation and SAP Business One support.

  1. 01
    REQUIREMENT / ANALYSIS

    Discover

    Before we propose anything, we work out what the requirement actually is. Not the one that was asked for aloud — the one the process needs.

    Requirement analysis
    We analyse the requirement before supplying the service, to identify exactly what is needed and map the solution to fit the purpose.
    ERP consultancy
    We help you choose the right ERP. We supply and support SAP Business One, and we evaluate other ERPs on their merits — for businesses in Sri Lanka and globally.
    Strategic consultancy
    Advisory across finance, marketing, supply chain management and operations management, aimed at an optimised business strategy.

    OutputA written requirement and a recommended route, with the trade-offs stated.

  2. 02
    ARCHITECTURE / MAPPING

    Design

    The right technology mapped onto the way the business operates — architecture before purchase order.

    Technology selection
    Platform, infrastructure and integration choices justified against fitness of purpose, cost and long-term maintainability rather than novelty.
    Solution architecture
    How the ERP, its companion applications, the infrastructure beneath it and the automation between them fit together.
    Scope and specification
    Specific, measurable, achievable, realistic and time-bound — the SMART objectives we work to on every engagement.

    OutputA scoped specification, a sequence, and a plan that fits the budget and the deadline.

  3. 03
    DELIVERY / BUILD

    Implement

    Configuration, development, integration and deployment — carried by a team that has done ERP implementations and other IT projects across industries.

    Customised add-on development
    Our development team listens to the requirement and builds precise, feasible add-ons around your ERP rather than bending it.
    ERP implementation
    Configuration, data migration, integration and deployment of the selected ERP platform.
    Project management
    A flexible implementation model dedicated to meeting your requirements within budget and deadlines, including for the challenges that arise along the way.

    OutputA running system, integrated where it needs to be, with the handover documented.

  4. 04
    SUPPORT / ADVANCE

    Improve

    Systems do not stay still. Neither do we — support, optimisation and the next increment of improvement.

    SAP Business One support
    Ongoing support for businesses running SAP Business One, wherever they are.
    Resource allocation
    Flexible access to our team of experts, with flexible billing, to manage the internal demands of your business.
    Infrastructure care
    Maintenance, security and virtualisation management keeping the foundation dependable.

    OutputA maintained system and a team already familiar with it — no re-briefing required.

Section: 07Why Axleta

What we hold to.

Every principle below is a description of something Axleta actually publishes it can do — not an aspiration and not a claim about results we cannot evidence.

  1. 01

    Business before system

    We map technology to the way your business actually operates. The process sets the requirement; the product answers it.

  2. 02

    Fitness of purpose

    We focus on practical technology choices that balance fit, cost and long-term maintainability — not on what is newest.

  3. 03

    ERP domain understanding

    SAP Business One and S/4HANA are not a product we resell. They are platforms we know well enough to configure, extend and support.

  4. 04

    Build, do not bolt on

    Where the ERP stops short, we build the companion application alongside it — so the data stays in one place and stays correct.

  5. 05

    The foundation counts

    Infrastructure, network, storage, security and virtualisation are designed in the same conversation as the application.

  6. 06

    Implementation and support

    Going live is the midpoint. Support, optimisation and the next increment are part of the engagement, not a separate sale.

  7. 07

    Partnership, not resale

    We work inside your business context and keep it current as the technology moves, rather than handing over and stepping back.
